name: basedesk
description: Open-source, self-hostable helpdesk with a fast, keyboard-first agent workspace.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w server
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w web && npm run typecheck -w server
